name: exa_mcp_agent
description: Advanced AI research assistant with 9 specialized tools: web search, code search (exa-code for GitHub/docs/StackOverflow), company research, LinkedIn search, URL crawling, deep research reports, and advanced filtering. Perfect for developers, researchers, and business intelligence.
useCases: General Web Research - Search the web for news, articles, and current information
Code & Documentation Search - Find GitHub repos, API docs, and StackOverflow answers with exa-code
Company Intelligence - Research companies, pricing, products, and business strategies
Professional Networking - Find LinkedIn profiles, executives, and industry experts
URL Analysis - Extract and summarize content from any article, blog post, or PDF
Deep Research Reports - Generate comprehensive AI-powered research reports on complex topics
Advanced Filtered Search - Search with category, domain, and date filters for precision
Competitive Analysis - Compare companies, products, and market positions with citations
Technical How-Tos - Get step-by-step coding guides from official docs and real examples
samplePrompts: Show me how to implement authentication in Next.js 14 App Router with code examples from GitHub
Research Anthropic's company profile, pricing tiers, and recent product launches
Find AI researchers and engineers who work at OpenAI on LinkedIn
Start a comprehensive deep research report on the impact of AI on healthcare in 2025
author: Albert Folch
